audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradict the page's own whys and the packet chart: rows 1 and 2 read Urgot while the prose says Gwen takes level 2 onward, row 6 (level 6) reads Gwen while the prose says it flips to you, and 2+ items reads Skill while the prose says you win.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Urgot / Urgot / Gwen / Urgot, and the content whys already agree with it on six of seven rows — only whys[3] (levels 4-5) claimed the lane stayed Gwen's. Adopting the packet chart therefore fixes the enum rows and needs just one why rewritten. Both layers are proposed together as one group.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Urgot / Urgot / Gwen / Urgot with ratings rescaled, and every why that contradicted a flipped row rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere despite Hallowed Mist being named on every second line.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Snip Snip! 6.5s down to 3.5s, Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s with a partial refund whenever she connects, Needlework 120/100/80s. Yours: Purge 12/9/6/3/0s at 490, Disdain 16s at rank 1, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s. The 22s mist is the number that makes levels 4-5 yours — it is too long to cover her whole rotation.
audit.corrected: Mist's 22s and Skip 'n Slash's refunding 13s now carry the advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states in five places that Fear Beyond Death 'ignores', 'bypasses' or 'doesn't care about' Hallowed Mist. Nothing in either kit supports that, and Riot's own text for the mist says the opposite about targeting.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist: 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' Fear Beyond Death is a targeted ability fired from up to 2500 range, so telling a player it pierces the cloud is exactly the kind of invented mechanic that gets them killed. Rather than asserting the reverse (which the text also does not spell out for this specific ability), every such line is rewritten to state what the text does say: to touch her you must be inside the mist, so the ult is spent on her step-out.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late and wants.you[1] rewritten around entering the mist or punishing the exit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is bought but never explained, the itemization line says 'his healing' about Gwen, and the on-hit threat is never named.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her for a portion of the bonus damage it deals to champions, so chip trades refund her; Skip 'n Slash grants attack speed, bonus range and magic on-hit, so her damage scales with attack speed and reading the trade purely through armour is wrong.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names the on-hit carrier and the Grievous Wounds requirement; the pronoun in report[8] fixed.

edits.before: This swings to you — R Fear Beyond Death ignores her W cloud immunity by flipping and executing her, and Skip 'n Slash mobility can't save a low Gwen from the leg execute once you land your ult.
edits.after: This swings to you — Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1, so spend it on her step-out rather than into the cloud: outside the mist she can be targeted, and outside the mist Skip 'n Slash cannot outrun the execute.

edits.before: Gwen spikes back with Nashor's/Riftmaker: her Q true damage and Skip 'n Slash resets let her whittle your HP faster than your Purge can shred her, and she just W-clouds out of your engage attempts.
edits.after: Gwen spikes back with Nashor's: Skip 'n Slash carries her on-hit damage and refunds part of its 13s on every connect, while A Thousand Cuts heals her off your health bar — hold Grievous Wounds before this fight.

edits.before: You reclaim it: as a tank-shredder your Purge and BC melt her HP-stacking bruiser build, and R remains a hard-lock answer that ignores Hallowed Mist and punishes her for dashing into your team.
edits.after: You reclaim it: Purge and Black Cleaver melt her health-stacked bruiser build, and the moment she dashes into your team she is standing outside her own mist — which is exactly when Fear Beyond Death lands.

edits.before: Levels 2-5 belong to Gwen: Hallowed Mist lets her ignore your Corrosive Charge and autos while her Q chunks you through armor, and her Skip 'n Slash kiting punishes your slow walk-up. Level 6 flips it decisively — R Fear Beyond Death doesn't care about her W immunity, so bait the cloud, flip her, and execute.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 belong to Gwen: from outside Hallowed Mist you cannot target her at all, Snip Snip! deals true damage down its centre, and Skip 'n Slash kiting punishes your slow walk-up. From 4 the mist's 22s stops covering her rotation — step into the cloud to fight her, and at 6 punish the moment she leaves it.

edits.before: At first item Gwen spikes again as Nashor's true-damage DPS and dash resets out-trade your sustain, and she can W out of your all-ins. But with 2+ items you take over: your Purge and Cleaver shred her health-stacked bruiser build faster than she kills you, and R stays a reliable lock-and-execute that ignores Hallowed Mist entirely.
edits.after: At first item Gwen spikes again: Nashor's on-hit rides Skip 'n Slash, whose 13s is partly refunded every time she connects, so she picks the trades and re-mists your all-ins. With 2+ items you take over — Purge and Cleaver shred her health-stacked build faster than she kills you, and your ult punishes every step she takes outside the mist.
